name: Session State
description: Hooks + scripts that maintain CONTEXT_STATE.md, MEMORY.md, and compact-resume state in each project's .claude/ directory. No process — a collection of shell scripts registered with Claude Code's hook system.

requirements._windows_note: Hooks are bash; Windows users need WSL2. PowerShell port is pending.

install._note: No venv or pip — session-state is just hook scripts. The launcher copies .claude/hooks/*.sh and .claude/scripts/*.py into each project folder when the module is enabled for that project.

settings.prompt: Warn if CONTEXT_STATE.md exceeds N lines
settings.description: A session-start hook surfaces a warning if the file gets too long.

settings.prompt: Warn if MEMORY.md exceeds N lines

runtime._note: Not a long-running process. The launcher installs the hooks by copying them into the user's project .claude/hooks/ directory and registering them in .claude/settings.json. This command is invoked only when the user clicks 'Run health check' in the module dashboard.

mcp_registration._note: Not an MCP — hook scripts run under Claude Code's hook system, not the MCP protocol.
